CLAUDE CODE REVIEW OF PERPLEXITY'S WORK — here's what I found:

knowledge.ts — parseLearnLines():
  Excellent. 14 categories, comprehensive field extraction (AP tables, scaling grades, status
  buildup, all 5 armor defense stats). The REMAP table for first-word classification is clean.
  The slash/arrow table parsers handle the messy AI output well. This is solid.

KnowledgeViewer.tsx — category-aware display modes:
  Love the context-aware tables: armor shows 5 defense columns, weapons show AP+scaling+status,
  lore/map use card lists, gem/upgrade show qty. Category tabs with page-aware filtering and
  the expandedRow pattern are clean UX. The color-coding per category is well-chosen.

SSE learn progress stream + LearnProgress.tsx:
  Good architecture — EventEmitter -> SSE -> React polling. The animated stage log is a nice touch.

════ BUGS I FOUND AND FIXED ════

1. KnowledgeViewer.tsx line 150: "fixed inset-0" → SAME Electron black screen bug we fixed on
   the team log panel. The root has overflow:hidden so fixed positioning breaks the renderer.
   FIXED → "absolute inset-0" (same fix as team log overlay).

2. buildKnowledgeBlock() was using DISPLAY_PER_CAT (150) for prompt injection.
   150 × 14 categories = 2100 facts max = ~210K chars. That's close to sonar-pro's 200K limit.
   FIXED → Added separate INJECT_PER_CAT = 60 for prompt injection (60×14 = 840 facts, ~85K).
   Storage stays at DISPLAY_PER_CAT = 150, MAX_FACTS = 1500. UI viewer unaffected.

   FIXED → updated comment.

  longer — their first 40 chars may be identical for similarly-named items from different

WHAT I JUST DID (fix better-sqlite3 ABI — correct approach):

COMMITTED: bb80b84

ROOT CAUSE (final diagnosis):
  Our manual electron-rebuild script was correctly recompiling better-sqlite3
  for Electron ABI 127, BUT electron-builder with npmRebuild:false was then
  packaging the OLD binary from node_modules anyway. The manual rebuild had
  no effect on what ended up inside the asar.

CORRECT FIX:
  - npmRebuild: true restored — electron-builder now handles the recompile
    itself, which guarantees the correct ABI binary ends up in the package
  - scripts/remove-bufferutil.cjs runs BEFORE electron-builder and deletes
    bufferutil from node_modules so electron-builder never tries to compile it
  - ws falls back to pure-JS automatically when bufferutil is absent
  - win:build: npm run build:electron && node scripts/remove-bufferutil.cjs && electron-builder --win --x64

NOTES FOR YOU (Claude):

WHAT I JUST DID (permanent ABI fix — replace better-sqlite3 with sql.js):

ROOT CAUSE (final):
  electron-rebuild + npmRebuild:true still packaged the wrong ABI binary because
  electron-builder controls which build it copies, and our timing/path was wrong.
  better-sqlite3 is a native .node module — it will ALWAYS have this fragility.

PERMANENT FIX: dropped better-sqlite3 entirely, replaced with sql.js (pure WebAssembly).
sql.js compiles SQLite to WASM — zero native binaries, zero ABI issues, works in
any Node version, any Electron version, no Visual Studio needed. Ever.
